scope: Two test-only files, four exact edits. No production, checker, role or timing changes.
review: The existing /run runtime directory block retains UID0/GID60001/mode02710 and is moved before creation of the ordinary registered identity paths.

workspace and fleet root are siblings beneath that existing runtime directory, set to UID0/GID60001/mode0710 immediately after original Registry initialization. These two directory roots grant only search to the dedicated group, not listing or writes.

HostAuthorityRegisteredIdentity.fleet_root is taken directly from the same original HeptaFleetRoot value used for Registry initialization; WorkspaceBinding and registered.workspace refer to the same actual new workspace.
The actual Registry register/Starting transition and FreshHostCognitiveState::prepare remain in original order. Fresh custody checks are not bypassed or replaced.
Child still calls the original sealed identity.identity() and propagates its error; only a phase-specific Context is added.

Root authority, current, physical witness, journal, consumer claims, artifact and model setup outside the declared edits remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The protected-directory denial assertion and every original stage, assertion and deadline are retained.

identity.facts: identity() rejects zero spawn generation and non-canonical fleet/workspace paths, then derives the same agent layout. It does not require UID60001 ownership or read/list access to these two directory roots.

registry.facts: initialize() creates and validates upper fleet directories. register() creates mode0700 staging and mode0700 home/run/logs/releases/cognitive/matrix/automation directories, then renames staging to the actual agent_root. Agent metadata/lifecycle/release files are beneath this private agent_root; ordinary OpenOptions defaults on those files do not make them accessible through the private ancestor.

layout.facts: Agent layout places writer.lock and generation cursor beneath agent_root/run and the cognitive store beneath agent_root/cognitive.

fresh.facts: validate_fresh_custody opens the actual agent_root and cognitive_root through RootAuthorityDirectory and matches the exact Registry Starting record, workspace, resources and layout. prepare() also opens run_root as Root-private and requires the actual writer lock to be Root-owned regular single-link mode0600.

root_directory.facts: RootAuthorityDirectory checks every ancestor is a physical UID0 directory without group/other write; the target private directory must have mode bits0700. UID0/GID60001/mode0710 ordinary ancestors satisfy this unchanged check, while the original agent/run/cognitive private targets remain required.

permission_source_pins.scope: No recursive chown/chmod occurs. The fixture's default-mode private record files remain behind the original mode0700 agent subtree, and separate Root authority/keys/current/witness protection is unchanged. This is a five-lane component path repair, not a complete non-Root Agentd filesystem deployment or grant.

limitations: Permission analysis is for the actual five-lane component fixture and its original Root storage setup. It does not supply a full Agentd filesystem handoff or make a new ordinary production deployment valid.
Original failed Root17 attempts remain failed. This patch needs a new fixed-source native run and establishes no test PASS by itself.
